locator.String: docs/divergent-universe-weighted-curio-overflow.md#base-damage-policy

note.String: VersionedProjectPolicy: base damage is 100 times released HardLevelGroup 1 HPRatio at the selected enemy's own immutable level, then multiplied by one plus the immutable battle contribution's Protocol maximum-HP increase. Use checked fixed-point multiplication, flooring to six fractional places after each multiplication; the shared final TrueDamage operation floors to integral damage. The source contains FixedValues 100 and a HPRatio read but does not establish this group, the opaque difficulty-query mapping, operator order or rounding. Group 1, Protocol HP scaling and these multiplication boundaries are independent low-confidence policies, not decoded postfix or observed parity.
